research_question: Can Trigger-2 preserve the distinction between identical claim content and promotion-bearing evidence when only provenance/minting authority differs?
hypothesis: A counterfactual probe that holds claim content and presentation constant while varying only evidence provenance can train/evaluate epistemic scope decisions without rewarding claim-content or layout shortcuts.
counterhypothesis: The task collapses to superficial provenance-token classification and therefore does not establish general evidence reasoning.
adjudication_boundary: The current probe establishes only a deterministic balanced evaluator blueprint and fail-closed source invariants. It does not establish model generalization, causal internal representation, runtime evidence, dataset admission, or training efficacy. Frozen paraphrase/OOD provenance carriers and model execution are required before any model-level claim.
negative_evidence_preserved: The first pre-commit local test draft exposed mutable aliasing in shared claim objects and two overly specific adversarial assertions. The generator was changed to deepcopy claim/provenance per row and the regressions were corrected before committed-byte validation. No credit is taken from that failed draft run.
next_discriminator: Before any training admission, create a frozen paraphrase/OOD successor in which the same provenance semantics are expressed through disjoint carrier vocabularies and structures, then require nuisance-only and lexical provenance-token baselines near chance while a semantic provenance evaluator remains solvable. Only after runtime quiescence and explicit model-execution admission may the selected Qwen3.5-0.8B checkpoint be tested on that frozen successor.
